summary:
Implementation plan to add the Product Maker (제조사) name to the Unit Price Integration Comparison Matrix.
- Update `matrixData` grouping logic to include the `maker` field for each vendor.
- Enhance the Matrix UI to display the maker name next to the percentage rate in a smaller, subdued font.
- Configure text wrapping for long maker names to maintain column integrity.
- Update the professional Excel export to include the maker name alongside the unit price.
